facts.name: Virginia Waterleaf
facts.notes: Leaves look water-stained in spring, then fuzzy lavender flower clusters follow. Spreads into a woodland carpet, so use it where it can roam.

companions.why: Commonly found with wild columbine, wild ginger, wild geranium, woodland phlox and mayapple.
